verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms PayPal serves an llms.txt at developer.paypal.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). A second probe confirms agent-friendly markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /api/rest.md), and the many .md doc URLs in the pack corroborate that machine-readable docs are served broadly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the llms.txt/markdown docs, and documentation describing the llms.txt structure or coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.paypal.com/llms.txt # PayPal Developer Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest.md # Get started with PayPal REST APIs (/api/rest)
